exposure: Accuracy of sonographic fetal weight estimation
outcome: Mode of delivery (primary cesarean section, secondary cesarean section, vaginal delivery, operative vaginal delivery)
cohort: 14,633 singleton pregnancies > 37 weeks gestation with ultrasound-estimated fetal weight within 7 days before delivery between 2002 and 2016
finding: Inaccuracies in sonographic estimation of fetal weight in cases of suspected macrosomia were found to have a greater impact on the mode of delivery than actual birth weight, with underestimation potentially increasing the risk of shoulder dystocia.
mod_finding: Sonographic EFW inaccuracies in fetal macrosomia appear to have a greater impact on the mode of delivery than birth weight itself.
